dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The words on these pages... Ugh, this writing's so blurred, Paimon can't make out what it says.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, is this the "mysterious ink bottle" that Wolfy mentioned?

choices.text: Looks like a perfectly normal ink bottle to me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that's true... Maybe Paimon's overthinking this. After all, you wouldn't usually find mysterious magical items like that just lying around, would you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Anyway, doesn't seem like there's anything worth looking at here. Let's go, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Let me have a quick taste...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: D—Don't do that! What else could ink taste like anyway!?
